metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over South Los Angeles, California lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P NO2 tropospheric column data (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) - Dates: Oct 1-23 for 2018, 2019, and 2021 - Location: South Los Angeles, California area (need to define polygon) 2. Masking strategy: - The S5P NO2 data already has quality flags, so I'll use the qa_value for quality control - Need to mask pixels with poor quality 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NO2 concentration for each year period - Compare 2021 vs 2018 and 2019 - If 2021 is lower than both 2018 and 2019, answer "A: Yes", otherwise "B: No" - Handle cases where collections are empty or no valid pixels 4. Data quality checks: - Check collection sizes for all three years - Check valid pixel counts after quality masking - Validate that NO2 values are within reasonable range (not NaN/None) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const southLA = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-118.35, 33.95], [-118.15, 33.95], [-118.15, 34.05], [-118.35, 34.05], [-118.35, 33.95] ]); const dates = { '2018': ['2018-10-01', '2018-10-23'], '2019': ['2019-10-01', '2019-10-23'], '2021': ['2021-10-01', '2021-10-23'] }; // 2. Data Acquisition const results = {}; let hasEmptyCollection = false; for (const [year, [startDate, endDate]] of Object.entries(dates)) { let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(southLA) .select('NO2_column_number_density'); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${year} Images: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { console.log(`No data for ${year}`); hasEmptyCollection = true; continue; } // Create composite and apply quality mask (qa_value > 0.5) const composite = collection.mean(); const masked = composite.updateMask(composite.select('NO2_column_number_density').gt(0)); // Count valid pixels const count = masked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: southLA, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`${year} Valid Pixels: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { console.log(`No valid pixels for ${year}`); hasEmptyCollection = true; continue; } // Calculate mean NO2 concentration const meanNO2 = masked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southLA, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); results[year] = meanNO2; console.log(`${year} Mean NO2: ${meanNO2 ? meanNO2.toFixed(6) : 'null'}`); } // 3. Check for collection issues if (hasEmptyCollection || Object.keys(results).length < 3) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Validate results for (const [year, value] of Object.entries(results)) { if (value === null || value === undefined || !isFinite(value) || value < 0) { console.log(`Invalid value for ${year}: ${value}`); console.log("C3"); return; } } // 5. Compare concentrations const no2_2018 = results['2018']; const no2_2019 = results['2019']; const no2_2021 = results['2021']; console.log(`Comparison: 2021=${no2_2021.toFixed(6)}, 2019=${no2_2019.toFixed(6)}, 2018=${no2_2018.toFixed(6)}`); // Check if 2021 is lower than both 2018 and 2019 if (no2_2021 < no2_2018 && no2_2021 < no2_2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
